get.summary: Get a page of a smartie (saved list configuration)
get.description:
Runs a saved list configuration (columns, filters, sorting) and returns one page of it.

**The keys of each `data` row are the smartie's configured columns, not the entity schema.** A smartie can include columns joined from related entities (aliased `<fkPrefix>_<ATTRIBUTE>`, e.g. `TIDD_NOMBRE`, `ALIV_PORCENTAJE`), which is why the response may contain fields that do not appear in this entity's own attributes. The `columns` array of the response always describes exactly what came back.

Columns whose attribute group the caller cannot see are dropped from both `data` and `columns`. If you need a stable, explicit column set, prefer `POST /CONCEPTO_DE_COBRO_EL/query`.

total.description: Total number of records matching the query (ignoring pagination)

columns.description: Definition of the columns actually returned - the authoritative list of the keys present in `data`

post.description: Performs a dynamic query on Concepto de cobro electrónico instances with custom columns, filters, sorting, aggregations, and configurable pagination. Use this endpoint for production-grade listings that require predictable performance, payload control, and advanced filtering. Unlike /search, /query allows explicit column selection and page size configuration, making it the preferred option for list screens, integrations, and high-volume data retrieval scenarios. This endpoint allows ad-hoc queries without requiring a saved smartie configuration.

requestBody.description: Dynamic query parameters including pagination, columns, filters, and search criteria

search.description: Free-text term applied over the requested columns: a LIKE '%term%' against each column in `columns` whose data type supports it, OR-ed together. It narrows both `data` and `total`. Combine it with `filters` for exact conditions.

field.description: Physical column name (required). Available columns from entity view, plus the raw id of Usuario-typed attributes (e.g. ORDC_SOLICITADA_POR) even though the resolved username (e.g. ORDC_SOLICITADA_POR_NOMBRE) is offered separately - request the raw id to cross-reference against your own user directory instead of the resolved display name.

columns.description: Column specifications. If null or empty, default header columns will be used

columnName.description: Column name to filter (required). Available columns from `columns` (entity view columns plus the raw id of Usuario-typed attributes), plus the physical id of related entities (e.g. CLIE_ID_CLIE) which - unlike Usuario ids - are filter-only: filtering by the related id doesn't need the related row's data, only the row's id, so it's supported here even though selecting/sorting by it isn't.

value.description: Value to compare. Type should match column data type

data.description: Rows of the page, keyed by the `field` of each requested column. `id` and `ESTA_CODIGO` are added when the rows represent instances (i.e. no column uses an aggregation).

total.description: Total number of records matching the query (ignoring pagination)

**The keys of each `data` row are the smartie's configured columns, not the entity schema.** A smartie can include columns joined from related entities (aliased `<fkPrefix>_<ATTRIBUTE>`, e.g. `TIDD_NOMBRE`, `ALIV_PORCENTAJE`), which is why the response may contain fields that do not appear in this entity's own attributes. The `columns` array of the response always describes exactly what came back.

Columns whose attribute group the caller cannot see are dropped from both `data` and `columns`. If you need a stable, explicit column set, prefer `POST /LIQUIDACION_DE_COBRO/query`.

post.summary: Execute dynamic query without persisted smartie
post.description: Performs a dynamic query on Cuenta bancaria instances with custom columns, filters, sorting, aggregations, and configurable pagination. Use this endpoint for production-grade listings that require predictable performance, payload control, and advanced filtering. Unlike /search, /query allows explicit column selection and page size configuration, making it the preferred option for list screens, integrations, and high-volume data retrieval scenarios. This endpoint allows ad-hoc queries without requiring a saved smartie configuration.

requestBody.description: Dynamic query parameters including pagination, columns, filters, and search criteria

search.description: Free-text term applied over the requested columns: a LIKE '%term%' against each column in `columns` whose data type supports it, OR-ed together. It narrows both `data` and `total`. Combine it with `filters` for exact conditions.

field.description: Physical column name (required). Available columns from entity view, plus the raw id of Usuario-typed attributes (e.g. ORDC_SOLICITADA_POR) even though the resolved username (e.g. ORDC_SOLICITADA_POR_NOMBRE) is offered separately - request the raw id to cross-reference against your own user directory instead of the resolved display name.

columns.description: Column specifications. If null or empty, default header columns will be used

columnName.description: Column name to filter (required). Available columns from `columns` (entity view columns plus the raw id of Usuario-typed attributes), plus the physical id of related entities (e.g. CLIE_ID_CLIE) which - unlike Usuario ids - are filter-only: filtering by the related id doesn't need the related row's data, only the row's id, so it's supported here even though selecting/sorting by it isn't.

value.description: Value to compare. Type should match column data type

data.description: Rows of the page, keyed by the `field` of each requested column. `id` and `ESTA_CODIGO` are added when the rows represent instances (i.e. no column uses an aggregation).

get.summary: Get a page of a smartie (saved list configuration)
get.description:
Runs a saved list configuration (columns, filters, sorting) and returns one page of it.

**The keys of each `data` row are the smartie's configured columns, not the entity schema.** A smartie can include columns joined from related entities (aliased `<fkPrefix>_<ATTRIBUTE>`, e.g. `TIDD_NOMBRE`, `ALIV_PORCENTAJE`), which is why the response may contain fields that do not appear in this entity's own attributes. The `columns` array of the response always describes exactly what came back.

Columns whose attribute group the caller cannot see are dropped from both `data` and `columns`. If you need a stable, explicit column set, prefer `POST /EXTRACTO/query`.

total.description: Total number of records matching the query (ignoring pagination)

columns.description: Definition of the columns actually returned - the authoritative list of the keys present in `data`

post.summary: Execute dynamic query without persisted smartie
post.description: Performs a dynamic query on Extracto Bancario instances with custom columns, filters, sorting, aggregations, and configurable pagination. Use this endpoint for production-grade listings that require predictable performance, payload control, and advanced filtering. Unlike /search, /query allows explicit column selection and page size configuration, making it the preferred option for list screens, integrations, and high-volume data retrieval scenarios. This endpoint allows ad-hoc queries without requiring a saved smartie configuration.

requestBody.description: Dynamic query parameters including pagination, columns, filters, and search criteria

search.description: Free-text term applied over the requested columns: a LIKE '%term%' against each column in `columns` whose data type supports it, OR-ed together. It narrows both `data` and `total`. Combine it with `filters` for exact conditions.

field.description: Physical column name (required). Available columns from entity view, plus the raw id of Usuario-typed attributes (e.g. ORDC_SOLICITADA_POR) even though the resolved username (e.g. ORDC_SOLICITADA_POR_NOMBRE) is offered separately - request the raw id to cross-reference against your own user directory instead of the resolved display name.

columns.description: Column specifications. If null or empty, default header columns will be used

columnName.description: Column name to filter (required). Available columns from `columns` (entity view columns plus the raw id of Usuario-typed attributes), plus the physical id of related entities (e.g. CLIE_ID_CLIE) which - unlike Usuario ids - are filter-only: filtering by the related id doesn't need the related row's data, only the row's id, so it's supported here even though selecting/sorting by it isn't.

value.description: Value to compare. Type should match column data type

data.description: Rows of the page, keyed by the `field` of each requested column. `id` and `ESTA_CODIGO` are added when the rows represent instances (i.e. no column uses an aggregation).

total.description: Total number of records matching the query (ignoring pagination)

columns.description: Definition of the columns actually returned - the authoritative list of the keys present in `data`

get.summary: Get a page of a smartie (saved list configuration)
get.description:
Runs a saved list configuration (columns, filters, sorting) and returns one page of it.

**The keys of each `data` row are the smartie's configured columns, not the entity schema.** A smartie can include columns joined from related entities (aliased `<fkPrefix>_<ATTRIBUTE>`, e.g. `TIDD_NOMBRE`, `ALIV_PORCENTAJE`), which is why the response may contain fields that do not appear in this entity's own attributes. The `columns` array of the response always describes exactly what came back.

Columns whose attribute group the caller cannot see are dropped from both `data` and `columns`. If you need a stable, explicit column set, prefer `POST /TRANSFERENCIA/query`.

total.description: Total number of records matching the query (ignoring pagination)

columns.description: Definition of the columns actually returned - the authoritative list of the keys present in `data`

post.summary: Execute dynamic query without persisted smartie
post.description: Performs a dynamic query on Transferencia instances with custom columns, filters, sorting, aggregations, and configurable pagination. Use this endpoint for production-grade listings that require predictable performance, payload control, and advanced filtering. Unlike /search, /query allows explicit column selection and page size configuration, making it the preferred option for list screens, integrations, and high-volume data retrieval scenarios. This endpoint allows ad-hoc queries without requiring a saved smartie configuration.

requestBody.description: Dynamic query parameters including pagination, columns, filters, and search criteria

search.description: Free-text term applied over the requested columns: a LIKE '%term%' against each column in `columns` whose data type supports it, OR-ed together. It narrows both `data` and `total`. Combine it with `filters` for exact conditions.

field.description: Physical column name (required). Available columns from entity view, plus the raw id of Usuario-typed attributes (e.g. ORDC_SOLICITADA_POR) even though the resolved username (e.g. ORDC_SOLICITADA_POR_NOMBRE) is offered separately - request the raw id to cross-reference against your own user directory instead of the resolved display name.

columns.description: Column specifications. If null or empty, default header columns will be used

columnName.description: Column name to filter (required). Available columns from `columns` (entity view columns plus the raw id of Usuario-typed attributes), plus the physical id of related entities (e.g. CLIE_ID_CLIE) which - unlike Usuario ids - are filter-only: filtering by the related id doesn't need the related row's data, only the row's id, so it's supported here even though selecting/sorting by it isn't.

value.description: Value to compare. Type should match column data type

data.description: Rows of the page, keyed by the `field` of each requested column. `id` and `ESTA_CODIGO` are added when the rows represent instances (i.e. no column uses an aggregation).

total.description: Total number of records matching the query (ignoring pagination)

columns.description: Definition of the columns actually returned - the authoritative list of the keys present in `data`

get.summary: Fast search endpoint. Returns a capped, non-paginated set of Caja records; prefer /query for controlled, production-grade listings.
get.description:
Performs a lightweight search over Caja instances. Every query parameter below that matches an attribute's physical name is applied as an equality filter; omit them all to list the first records. The result set is capped and not paginated, so this endpoint is meant for quick lookups. For production listings that require configurable pagination, explicit column selection, or advanced filters, prefer /query.

Only Caja's own attributes are returned here: a foreign key travels as its id (e.g. `XXXX_ID_XXXX`), not as the referenced instance's description. Columns joined from related entities (aliased `<fkPrefix>_<ATTRIBUTE>`, e.g. `TIDD_NOMBRE`) do exist, but they are list columns: request them explicitly through `POST /CAJA/query` (the `field` enum there lists every available column, related ones included) or add them to a smartie. For a single instance, `GET /CAJA/{id}?includeFkTexts=true` returns `attsFkTexts` with the descriptive text behind each foreign key.

get.summary: Get a page of a smartie (saved list configuration)
get.description:
Runs a saved list configuration (columns, filters, sorting) and returns one page of it.

**The keys of each `data` row are the smartie's configured columns, not the entity schema.** A smartie can include columns joined from related entities (aliased `<fkPrefix>_<ATTRIBUTE>`, e.g. `TIDD_NOMBRE`, `ALIV_PORCENTAJE`), which is why the response may contain fields that do not appear in this entity's own attributes. The `columns` array of the response always describes exactly what came back.

Columns whose attribute group the caller cannot see are dropped from both `data` and `columns`. If you need a stable, explicit column set, prefer `POST /CAJA/query`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-based). Defaults to 1 when omitted.

data.description: Rows of the page. Each row is keyed by the smartie's column names (related-entity columns included); `id` and `ESTA_CODIGO` are added when the rows represent instances (i.e. the query does not group or pivot).

total.description: Total number of records matching the query (ignoring pagination)

columns.description: Definition of the columns actually returned - the authoritative list of the keys present in `data`

post.summary: Execute dynamic query without persisted smartie
post.description: Performs a dynamic query on Caja instances with custom columns, filters, sorting, aggregations, and configurable pagination. Use this endpoint for production-grade listings that require predictable performance, payload control, and advanced filtering. Unlike /search, /query allows explicit column selection and page size configuration, making it the preferred option for list screens, integrations, and high-volume data retrieval scenarios. This endpoint allows ad-hoc queries without requiring a saved smartie configuration.

requestBody.description: Dynamic query parameters including pagination, columns, filters, and search criteria

search.description: Free-text term applied over the requested columns: a LIKE '%term%' against each column in `columns` whose data type supports it, OR-ed together. It narrows both `data` and `total`. Combine it with `filters` for exact conditions.

field.description: Physical column name (required). Available columns from entity view, plus the raw id of Usuario-typed attributes (e.g. ORDC_SOLICITADA_POR) even though the resolved username (e.g. ORDC_SOLICITADA_POR_NOMBRE) is offered separately - request the raw id to cross-reference against your own user directory instead of the resolved display name.

columns.description: Column specifications. If null or empty, default header columns will be used

columnName.description: Column name to filter (required). Available columns from `columns` (entity view columns plus the raw id of Usuario-typed attributes), plus the physical id of related entities (e.g. CLIE_ID_CLIE) which - unlike Usuario ids - are filter-only: filtering by the related id doesn't need the related row's data, only the row's id, so it's supported here even though selecting/sorting by it isn't.

value.description: Value to compare. Type should match column data type

data.description: Rows of the page, keyed by the `field` of each requested column. `id` and `ESTA_CODIGO` are added when the rows represent instances (i.e. no column uses an aggregation).

total.description: Total number of records matching the query (ignoring pagination)

columns.description: Definition of the columns actually returned - the authoritative list of the keys present in `data`

400.description: Bad request - invalid parameters, unknown column name, or unsupported operator

total.description: Total number of records matching the query (ignoring pagination)

columns.description: Definition of the columns actually returned - the authoritative list of the keys present in `data`

post.summary: Execute dynamic query without persisted smartie
post.description: Performs a dynamic query on Pago rápido de caja instances with custom columns, filters, sorting, aggregations, and configurable pagination. Use this endpoint for production-grade listings that require predictable performance, payload control, and advanced filtering. Unlike /search, /query allows explicit column selection and page size configuration, making it the preferred option for list screens, integrations, and high-volume data retrieval scenarios. This endpoint allows ad-hoc queries without requiring a saved smartie configuration.

requestBody.description: Dynamic query parameters including pagination, columns, filters, and search criteria

search.description: Free-text term applied over the requested columns: a LIKE '%term%' against each column in `columns` whose data type supports it, OR-ed together. It narrows both `data` and `total`. Combine it with `filters` for exact conditions.

field.description: Physical column name (required). Available columns from entity view, plus the raw id of Usuario-typed attributes (e.g. ORDC_SOLICITADA_POR) even though the resolved username (e.g. ORDC_SOLICITADA_POR_NOMBRE) is offered separately - request the raw id to cross-reference against your own user directory instead of the resolved display name.

columns.description: Column specifications. If null or empty, default header columns will be used

columnName.description: Column name to filter (required). Available columns from `columns` (entity view columns plus the raw id of Usuario-typed attributes), plus the physical id of related entities (e.g. CLIE_ID_CLIE) which - unlike Usuario ids - are filter-only: filtering by the related id doesn't need the related row's data, only the row's id, so it's supported here even though selecting/sorting by it isn't.

value.description: Value to compare. Type should match column data type

data.description: Rows of the page, keyed by the `field` of each requested column. `id` and `ESTA_CODIGO` are added when the rows represent instances (i.e. no column uses an aggregation).

total.description: Total number of records matching the query (ignoring pagination)

columns.description: Definition of the columns actually returned - the authoritative list of the keys present in `data`

get.summary: Get a page of a smartie (saved list configuration)
get.description:
Runs a saved list configuration (columns, filters, sorting) and returns one page of it.

**The keys of each `data` row are the smartie's configured columns, not the entity schema.** A smartie can include columns joined from related entities (aliased `<fkPrefix>_<ATTRIBUTE>`, e.g. `TIDD_NOMBRE`, `ALIV_PORCENTAJE`), which is why the response may contain fields that do not appear in this entity's own attributes. The `columns` array of the response always describes exactly what came back.

Columns whose attribute group the caller cannot see are dropped from both `data` and `columns`. If you need a stable, explicit column set, prefer `POST /CASHFLOW/query`.

total.description: Total number of records matching the query (ignoring pagination)

columns.description: Definition of the columns actually returned - the authoritative list of the keys present in `data`

Runs a saved list configuration (columns, filters, sorting) and returns one page of it.

**The keys of each `data` row are the smartie's configured columns, not the entity schema.** A smartie can include columns joined from related entities (aliased `<fkPrefix>_<ATTRIBUTE>`, e.g. `TIDD_NOMBRE`, `ALIV_PORCENTAJE`), which is why the response may contain fields that do not appear in this entity's own attributes. The `columns` array of the response always describes exactly what came back.

Columns whose attribute group the caller cannot see are dropped from both `data` and `columns`. If you need a stable, explicit column set, prefer `POST /PROFIT_AND_LOSS/query`.

post.description: Performs a dynamic query on Profit and Loss instances with custom columns, filters, sorting, aggregations, and configurable pagination. search.description: Free-text term applied over the requested columns: a LIKE '%term%' against each column in `columns` whose data type supports it, OR-ed together. It narrows both `data` and `total`. Combine it with `filters` for exact conditions.

field.description: Physical column name (required). columnName.description: Column name to filter (required). data.description: Rows of the page, keyed by the `field` of each requested column. `id` and `ESTA_CODIGO` are added when the rows represent instances (i.e. no column uses an aggregation).

total.description: Total number of records matching the query (ignoring pagination)
